# Roomly, a new service for booking meeting rooms

For immediate release, 1 October 2026

Minato Works today announced Roomly, a cloud service for booking meeting rooms. It goes on sale on Monday, 2 November 2026 for offices of any size. The booking screen and the panel at each door read one calendar. A room that looks free on screen is free in the corridor.

## Why we built it

Our office managers answered questions about double bookings almost every week. The old booking sheet was a shared spreadsheet, and a meeting that ended early still held its slot. People often walked to a room only to find it empty.

We tested the first version with three teams in the spring of 2026. We measured the questions about rooms during the trial. They fell by about half in 8 weeks.

## What the service does

A person leaving a room presses the panel, and the rest of the slot opens at once. The service releases a booking that nobody claims within 10 minutes. Each team will see its own rooms at the top of the list. Office managers get a monthly table with the hours booked, the hours used, and the hours lost.

The service runs on the door panel, the reception tablet, and any web browser. The office manager should register each room before the first booking.

## Price and setup

The service costs 2,000 yen per room each month, with no setup fee. An engineer will visit the office to meet the facilities team, count the rooms, and plan where each panel goes. Setup takes about two weeks after the contract is signed by both sides.

## Contact

Companies that want to discuss a trial can write to our sales team at sales@example.com. The sales team will answer on weekdays between 9:00 and 17:00.
